clips.title: He Doesn't Even Need an Interpreter

lines.ja: イーレイは、日本語も普通に喋れます。
lines.en: Yi-Lei can speak Japanese normally too.
lines.speaker: Yazawa

lines.ja: だから、通訳いらないっすね。本当に。
lines.en: So he doesn't need an interpreter. Seriously.
lines.speaker: Yazawa

lines.ja: 多分、寮で勉強してるんですよ。
lines.en: He's probably studying at the dormitory.
lines.speaker: Yazawa

lines.ja: 日本語の先生みたいな方と。頭いいっす、めちゃめちゃ。
lines.en: With someone like a Japanese teacher. He's super smart.
lines.speaker: Yazawa

lines.ja: すごい色んな言葉覚えてるし、賢いなと思います。
lines.en: He learns so many words, so I think he's really clever.
lines.speaker: Yazawa

clips.title: Studying Hard to Communicate
grammar: 〜たり〜たりする — doing things like

lines.ja: イーレイでも勉強熱心で、
lines.en: Yi-Lei is really eager to learn,
lines.speaker: Hosokawa

lines.ja: 毎週多分日本語の授業を受けたりとかして、
lines.en: taking Japanese classes every week and all,
lines.speaker: Hosokawa

lines.ja: 必死にみんなと通訳を介さずに、
lines.en: and trying desperately without an interpreter
lines.speaker: Hosokawa

lines.ja: コミュニケーションをめっちゃ取ってくれるんで、
lines.en: to communicate with everyone a lot,
lines.speaker: Hosokawa

lines.ja: もう今通訳なしでも全然喋れるぐらい日本語うまいんで、
lines.en: and his Japanese is already good enough that he speaks totally fine without an interpreter.
lines.speaker: Hosokawa

clips.title: Welcomed to the Major League Roster
grammar: 〜よろしくお願いします — please treat me well

lines.ja: 本日より孫易磊投手、支配下登録されました。よろしくお願いします！
lines.en: As of today, pitcher Sun Yi-Lei has been added to the main roster. Let's give him a warm welcome!
lines.speaker: Staff

lines.ja: これからよろしくお願いします！
lines.en: I look forward to working with you all!
lines.speaker: Sun
